meta.intro: The Digital Infrastructure Readiness Index compares digital infrastructure readiness across 196 countries using 5 pillars. All scores shown here are generated placeholder content for design and testing.

methodology.framework:
## Framework

The Digital Infrastructure Readiness Index is organised around five pillars: Infrastructure, Regulatory environment, Skills and talent, Investment and finance, and Adoption and usage. Each pillar is scored independently for every country, and an optional composite score summarises a country's overall position.

This is placeholder framework text pending the finalised methodology.
methodology.scoring:
## Scoring approach

Each country-pillar pair receives a score between 0 and 100, grouped into five bands: Limited, Developing, Established, Advanced, and Leading. Scores in this sample dataset are illustrative and do not reflect a completed assessment.
methodology.sources:
## Data sources

Sample references in this dataset point to publicly available sources, including the World Bank, the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), the OECD, and national telecommunications regulators. Real source citations will replace these once the index is finalised.
methodology.assumptions:
## Assumptions and limitations

- This is placeholder content for demonstration purposes only.
- Scores, rationale, and composite values do not represent a completed Crisil assessment.
- The scoring scale, bands, and pillar weights shown here are illustrative and subject to change.

meta.disclaimer: This index is illustrative sample content and does not constitute a credit rating, investment advice, or any assessment by Crisil or S&P Global. All scores, rationale, and references shown are placeholders pending the finalised index.
